name: Samuel Goode
bio: a Representative from Virginia; born in "Whitby," Chesterfield County, Va., March 21, 1756; completed preparatory studies; studied law; admitted to the bar and practiced; served in the Revolutionary War as a lieutenant in the Chesterfield Troop of Horse and later as a colonel of militia; member, Virginia state house of delegates, 1778-1785; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Sixth Congress (March 4, 1799-March 3, 1801); died in Invermay, Mecklenburg County, Va., November 14, 1822; interment on his estate near Invermay, Mecklenburg County, Va.
